liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- Viola Lee Blues is split into three parts, returning between other songs through the second set [2]
- Bobby plays acoustic guitar on the Ripple encore [2]
- A Stay jam is marked at The Wheel in the second set [2]
- Reviewer especially enjoyed the Estimated Prophet into Uncle John's Band segment, saying John sounded exactly right [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **dnco101**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]
- **dnco102**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]
- **dnco103**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]

- **dnco105**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]
- **dnco106**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]
- **dnco107**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]
- **dnco108**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]

## The recordings

- **DnCO2018-06-22.AlpineValley** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 196 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [1]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended both nights at the front of the lawn, before the concrete pit; weather was perfect [5]
- Yellow stage lights shone straight into the reviewer's eyes, and smoke was seen rising up the hillside [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **DnCO2018-06-22.AlpineValley**: taped by tyedyejon/taper jon; source: audience [1]. Also: Recorded with a pair of Sennheiser ME66 mics in XY into a Sound Devices MixPre6 at 24-bit/96kHz, then CD Wave and TLH; Mics were ten feet high, about 250 feet from the edge of the pavilion [1]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Alpine Valley Music Theatre: [Dead & Company Tickets | 22 June 2018 | Alpine Valley Music Theatre](https://alpinevalleymusictheatre.org/events/dead-company/) [8]
